maddeler.e:
نغلولب (form XII)
# نَغْلَوْلِبُ (naḡlawlibu) /naɣ.law.li.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْلَوْلَبَ (iḡlawlaba)
# نَغْلَوْلِبَ (naḡlawliba) /naɣ.law.li.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْلَوْلَبَ (iḡlawlaba)
# نَغْلَوْلِبْ (naḡlawlib) /naɣ.law.lib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِغْلَوْلَبَ (iḡlawlaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
